title: Plus Granite Lower
description: Lower body strengthening with pulse squats, curtsy lunges and single-leg hip thrusts

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Butt kicks
exercises.instructions: Run in place, heels toward the glutes

exercises.name: Hip 90/90
exercises.instructions: Seated, legs at 90 degrees, pivot from side to side

exercises.name: Deep squat hold
exercises.instructions: Hold a deep squat, back straight, elbows against the knees

exercises.name: Pulse squats
exercises.instructions: Hold the bottom of the squat, small up-and-down pulses

exercises.name: Curtsy lunges
exercises.instructions: Cross the leg behind in a diagonal

exercises.name: Single-leg hip thrust
exercises.instructions: Hip thrust on one leg, the other lifted

exercises.name: RKC plank
exercises.instructions: Plank with maximum tension, squeeze fists and glutes

exercises.name: Dead bug
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, arms and legs up, extend opposite arm/leg alternating

exercises.name: Toe touches
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, legs vertical, touch feet with hands

exercises.name: Pigeon stretch
exercises.instructions: Front leg bent in front, back leg extended, lean forward

exercises.name: Hamstring stretch
exercises.instructions: Leg extended forward, lean torso forward

exercises.name: Standing quad stretch
exercises.instructions: Grab your foot behind you, knee toward the floor

exercises.name: Deep breathing
exercises.instructions: Inhale 4s through the nose, hold 4s, exhale 6s through the mouth
